description: The append-only audit ledger of monitoring events for a practitioner on this account's roster (a practitioner screened or rostered by this key). Free (rate limited). Not covered: practitioners not on your roster (404). Entries made from sample data stay labelled as sample data. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.
name: get_practitioner_history
title: Show a practitioner's monitoring history
